limitations: Final new groups come from historically used development; not independent benchmark confirmation.
Supervised ridge fit inspected 60 fit labels; 11 fixed candidates were selected on 96 tuning labels.
Correct fit margins were softly penalized, not guaranteed unchanged; large scorer edits may affect other primitives.
Paired document-group bootstrap intervals are descriptive, without multiple-testing adjustment.
Cached final-linear scoring requires actual FP32 forward/restoration checks; no deployment change is authorized.
